protocol.primary: Fresh Gaussian FP32 QR pairs; held-out nonce labels and a disjoint carrier content-phrase pool; block 20 resid_pre at the carrier final period; rho=0.1; full 8-element mapping/demo/option counterfactual orbit; both test directions.
protocol.training: Online fresh vectors with localization and same/different curricula, followed by arbitrary label binding and an anneal from rho 0.5-2.0 to rho 0.02-0.2.
protocol.interpretation_limit: The result tests trained functional access to internal perturbations. It does not establish subjective introspection.

paired_improvement.cluster_unit: base episode, after averaging transformations and training seeds

audit.unit: one model × episode × test vector × counterfactual transform
